primary_papers.title: Freeze-in Dark Matter via Higgs Portal: Small-scale Problem

source_chunks_or_sections.quote_or_summary: The paper states that it constructs a realistic self-interacting freeze-in DM model via the SM Higgs portal.
The Lagrangian contains scalar fields X and Y, dark quartics, and feeble X^2|H|^2 and Y^2|H|^2 portal terms.
The text gives classical-regime ranges alpha_D 0.1-0.9, m_Y 2-7 MeV, and m_X 60-500 GeV.

unresolved_items: Detailed numeric portal-coupling ranges are figure-dependent in the extracted text.
No full phase-space distribution function is provided in text form.

caveats: Sommerfeld effects are included analytically for completeness but are negligible for the freeze-in rate in the paper's discussion.
